_about: Public-domain Samuel Kirkland Lothrop (1804-1886), Unitarian minister of the Brattle Square Church, Boston, for the Word Hoard: his Life of Samuel Kirkland, A History of the Church in Brattle Street, and his sermons (1842-1874). The archaeologist of the same name (1892-1965) is a different man and is left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 97 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
